name: Metro Healthcare Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司完成收购RMC Specialist Sdn Bhd全部股权（现金代价RM320,000），并推进以4股现有普通股送1份凭单的免费凭单发行计划。此外，公司宣派中期股息每股0.25仙。
overview_en: In 2026, the company completed the acquisition of 100% equity interest in RMC Specialist Sdn Bhd for a cash consideration of RM320,000, and progressed a bonus issue of free warrants on the basis of 1 warrant for every 4 existing ordinary shares. The company also declared an interim dividend of 0.25 sen per ordinary share.

segments.name: 住院、门诊及日间护理
segments.note: 该板块通过收购RMC Specialist扩展业务。
segments.note_en: This segment expanded its business through the acquisition of RMC Specialist.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 完成收购RMC Specialist Sdn Bhd全部股权，现金代价RM320,000。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of 100% equity interest in RMC Specialist Sdn Bhd for a cash consideration of RM320,000.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团层面推进免费凭单发行及宣派中期股息。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the company progressed a bonus issue of free warrants and declared an interim dividend.

actions.title: METRO - BONUS ISSUE OF 244,726,244 NEW WARRANTS IN METRO ("WARRANTS") ON THE BASIS OF 1 WARRANT FOR EVERY 4 EXISTING ORDINARY SHARES HELD ("
actions.text_en: Proposed bonus issue of up to 244,726,244 free warrants on the basis of 1 warrant for every 4 existing ordinary shares held.

actions.title: METRO - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣派中期股息每股0.25仙，除权日为2026年4月6日。
actions.text_en: Declared an interim dividend of 0.25 sen per ordinary share, with ex-date on 6 April 2026.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过收购RMC Specialist Sdn Bhd全部股权，将该公司纳入集团业务。
model_changes.text_en: Acquired 100% equity interest in RMC Specialist Sdn Bhd, bringing the company into the group.
